seed_data.pdp_official_description_raw: Reveal soft, refreshed, and nourished skin with the 7 Journeys Miracle Glow Serum Mask. Each sheet is soaked in a highly concentrated serum that delivers hydration and nourishment with a blend of natural extracts, including Acai, Blueberry, Strawberry, and other superfruits, as well as niacinamide, panthenol, and ceramides. Infused with Macadamia Oil, Evening Primrose Oil, Centella Asiatica, and Madecassoside, the mask supports moisture retention while promoting a smooth and supple skin texture. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, the lightweight mask is easy to use and absorbs quickly without irritation. Free from fragrances, parabens, sulfates, and silicones, and vegan-friendly, it is perfect for a clean, nourishing skincare routine. With consistent use, your skin feels refreshed, hydrated, and naturally radiant. pdp_details_sections.heading: Details
pdp_details_sections.body: The 7 Journeys Miracle Glow Serum Mask is your perfect skincare companion for deep hydration, soothing relief, and a radiant complexion. Crafted with care for all skin types , especially dry, sensitive, and dull skin , this mask delivers a powerful boost of moisture while enhancing skin’s natural glow. Infused with our patented ANTARCTICINE® — a unique ingredient known for its skin-strengthening and anti-aging support — this serum mask works to protect your skin against environmental stressors and promote elasticity. Complemented by a rich blend of antioxidant-packed berry extracts and niacinamide , it helps reduce uneven skin tone and brightens your complexion for a healthy, luminous finish. Key ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and glycerin provide intense hydration, locking in moisture to leave your skin feeling soft and supple. Meanwhile, centella asiatica compounds soothe irritation and calm redness, making it especially gentle for sensitive skin. This vegan-certified, clean formula is free from parabens, sulfates, artificial fragrances, alcohol, and mineral oils — ensuring a pure and safe experience for your skin.
